rules: Development experiment on a previously explored structural split; no global-minimum claim.
All newly trained priors use the same frozen 244 strict-bank cards and original train/validation flags. Random masks, no IMP. The relaxed bank is only a frozen reference.
Train 3 prior seeds and retain all checkpoints. Screen width, learning rate, weight decay, training duration, corruption, KL strength and task weighting.

Joint AR fits the entire mask. Token corruption replaces input bits independently with draws from their empirical marginals; cross-output corruption replaces the foreign output column with that from an independent source card. Targets remain genuine source masks.

Cross-output corruption, independent output AR, and partwise VAE explicitly use the known two-output architecture. They do not receive teacher coordinate roles or target masks. These are composition inductive biases, not discovery of arbitrary modules.

Token/cross corruption is tested during training only and also during generation. Plain temperature divides AR logits; VAE sampling scale multiplies its standard-normal latent and is not a logit temperature.

NF means Neural Functional. Reuse the archived NF/VAE architecture; reconstruct normalized source weights/query gradients from the frozen cards. Mask-only VAE controls use masks and zero gradients in the same encoder. Every target numerical weight is fresh.
Use original card-frequency weighting by default for all models, with explicit task-balanced controls. No invented whole-mask labels from target data.

Screen on fresh numerical calibration functions of familiar pairs and remainder-2 calibration pairs, weighting both conditions equally by empirical query MSE. All candidate epochs participate; source-card NLL is diagnostic, not the final model-selection criterion.

Confirm the two best settings per family on separate calibration functions and more searches. Tune numerical SGD and allocation within a fixed 4194304-example target budget. Keep baseline protocols as separate controls.
Write the final selection before generating target functions. Target remainder-3 pairs and familiar pairs use new functions; no target-based retuning.
Preserve all existing runs. Keep raw selected-candidate data, fitting trajectories, model checkpoints, calibration scores, and source hashes. Do not create or run test suites.
